ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions occupy the distal two-thirds of both lobes. A central low-intensity black region forms a widening vertical band from the peduncle to the trailing edge. High-frequency black mottling and stippling are localized at the boundary transition between the dark central core and light distal lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations. Distinct jagged peaks are visible at the distal tips, while the mid-lobe edges show smoother, lower-frequency variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double-curved sigmoidal trajectory; convex curvature near the median notch transitioning to a concave sweep towards the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity irregular pixels located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with localized calcified formations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear segments oriented irregularly across the dark central pigmentation, particularly visible to the left of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white linear scarring and rake marks concentrated in the central dark pigmentation zone; prominent irregular textured masses on both distal tips.
